from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    frames=[]
    # Find monochrome rectangular borders (at least 3x3), then preserve their border.
    for color in set(v for row in grid for v in row)-{0}:
        cells={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==color}
        # components
        while cells:
            seed=cells.pop(); comp={seed}; stack=[seed]
            while stack:
                r,c=stack.pop()
                for p in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                    if p in cells:
                        cells.remove(p); comp.add(p); stack.append(p)
            rs=[p[0] for p in comp]; cs=[p[1] for p in comp]
            t,b,l,rr=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
            if b-t<2 or rr-l<2: continue
            border={(r,c) for r in range(t,b+1) for c in range(l,rr+1) if r in (t,b) or c in (l,rr)}
            if comp==border:
                frames.append((color,t,b,l,rr))
    border_cells=set()
    for col,t,b,l,rr in frames:
        for r in range(t,b+1):
            for c in range(l,rr+1):
                if r in (t,b) or c in (l,rr):
                    out[r][c]=col; border_cells.add((r,c))
    counts=Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0,) and (r,c) not in border_cells)
    for col,t,b,l,rr in frames:
        interior=[(r,c) for r in range(t+1,b) for c in range(l+1,rr)]
        pattern=[p for p in interior if (p[0]+p[1])%2==(t+1+l+1)%2]
        # The marker count selects which of the two checkerboard phases is used.
        other=[p for p in interior if p not in set(pattern)]
        chosen=pattern if counts.get(col,0)==len(pattern) else other
        target=next((v for v,n in counts.items() if n==len(chosen)),None)
        if target is None:
            # Try either phase by matching the unique scattered-color count.
            target=next((v for v,n in counts.items() if n in (len(pattern),len(other))),None)
            if target is not None and counts[target]==len(other): chosen=other
        if target is not None:
            for r,c in chosen: out[r][c]=target
    return out
PY

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    frames = []
    seen = set()
    # Locate each connected component that is a complete rectangular outline.
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            comp = {(r, c)}
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                for p in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    py, px = p
                    if 0 <= py < h and 0 <= px < w and grid[py][px] == color and p not in seen:
                        seen.add(p); comp.add(p); stack.append(p)
            top, bottom = min(y for y,x in comp), max(y for y,x in comp)
            left, right = min(x for y,x in comp), max(x for y,x in comp)
            if bottom-top < 2 or right-left < 2:
                continue
            border = {(y,x) for y in range(top,bottom+1) for x in range(left,right+1)
                      if y in (top,bottom) or x in (left,right)}
            if comp == border:
                frames.append((color,top,bottom,left,right))
    border_cells = set()
    for color, top,bottom,left,right in frames:
        for y in range(top,bottom+1):
            for x in range(left,right+1):
                if y in (top,bottom) or x in (left,right):
                    border_cells.add((y,x))
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(grid[y][x] for y in range(h) for x in range(w)
                     if grid[y][x] != 0 and (y,x) not in border_cells)
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for color,top,bottom,left,right in frames:
        for y in range(top,bottom+1):
            for x in range(left,right+1):
                if y in (top,bottom) or x in (left,right):
                    out[y][x] = color
    for color,top,bottom,left,right in frames:
        cells = [(y,x) for y in range(top+1,bottom) for x in range(left+1,right)
                 if (y+x) % 2 == (top+1+left+1) % 2]
        target = next((v for v,n in counts.items() if n == len(cells)), None)
        if target is not None:
            for y,x in cells:
                out[y][x] = target
    return out
PY
